description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Pious Evangel triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Thopter and Phyrexian Mite die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
